author: marcfeuermann
body: No worries, you couldn't have known. The advantage of looking at the tree is that you see all sorts of things you wouldn't otherwise see... and believe me, there are some things you wouldn't want to see ;-) There are some tree sections, or sometimes whole trees that are just impossible to PAINT even if we have some nice evidence. I think these trees really should be reviewed before attempting to propagate annotations.
